description: This is a Java controller class for handling theater or event shows ('Espetaculos') within a web application, providing endpoints for listing, creating, and managing show sessions and reservations.

classes.name: EspetaculosController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling web requests related to 'Espetaculos' including listing, adding sessions, and reservations, integrating domain logic with the web framework.

methods.name: lista
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all available 'espeta' shows and includes the list of 'estabelecimentos' in the result.

methods.name: adiciona
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new 'Espetaculo', validating its name and description.

methods.name: sessao
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display details of a specific session by ID.

methods.name: reserva
methods.description: Handles POST requests to reserve seats for a session, validating availability and requested quantity.

methods.name: sessoes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list sessions of a specific 'Espetaculo'.

methods.name: cadastraSessoes
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new sessions for a specific 'Espetaculo' over a date range with specified times and periodicity.

methods.name: carregaEspetaculo
methods.description: Loads an 'Espetaculo' by ID, handling validation and not-found errors.

methods.name: criaEstabelecimento
methods.description: Creates an 'Estabelecimento' object, currently returning the first in the list; placeholder for actual creation logic.
